title: How to play
summary: Story stage EX-3 EVENT; challenge mode opens once it is cleared.

sections.title: Rules
items: Score as high as you can (capped at 999,999)
Tap the left or right side (A / D) to walk; tap the same side twice to dash
2 — each egg that hits Soda costs one
Walks at 2.5, dashes 1.75 units at 6 (the game’s units)
Story and challenge use their own (identical) difficulty tables

sections.title: Difficulty over time
sections.note: A new level every 5 s. Every spawn drops a handful of objects; the egg share grows and everything falls faster. Times are read as 1/10,000 s; fall speed is the table’s multiplier (per 10,000).

pages.title: Catch the Coin, Soda! - Story Mode
pages.text:
■ This is a game where you collect falling gold coins.
■ Tap the two sides of the screen to move Soda. (Shortcut keys: A, D)
■ Tap the same spot twice and Soda will sprint.
■ Soda's HP will decrease if she gets hit by falling eggs.
■ In the story mode, achieve the target score to clear the stage.

pages.title: Catch the Coin, Soda! - Challenge Mode
pages.text:
■ This is a game where you collect the falling gold coins.
■ Tap the two sides of the screen to move Soda. (Shortcut keys: A, D)
■ Tap the same spot twice and Soda will sprint.
■ Soda's HP will decrease if she gets hit by falling eggs.
■ In the challenge mode, your goal is to get the highest score possible.
